architecture_scope_line: Current public desktop scope covers Linux x64, macOS ARM64, and Windows x64 only. No public route is posted for Windows ARM64, Linux ARM64, and macOS x64 on the current shelf.
claim_boundary_line: Preview proof, fallback routes, artifact explainers, and packet-detail artifacts can show real progress, but flagship wording is reserved for surfaces that independently clear the flagship acceptance bar.
desktop_pick_line: If you see both desktop apps, start with the Avalonia. Treat Blazor Desktop as a fallback path only when the download page or support explicitly tells you to use it.
fix_availability_summary: That warning will stay in place until the missing desktop installer proof is posted.
known_issue_summary: Public installers are still missing for Windows and macOS.
missing_installer_lane_line: Still missing from the promoted installer lane: Windows and macOS.
proof_scope_line: Proof on the public shelf is scoped to the posted files, named flows, and recent checks you can inspect today; it is not a blanket flagship-complete claim and it does not outrank the recommended install route.
quality_gap_line: Character math is already solid. The rough edges are mostly installer polish, update polish, and support polish.
release_verification_summary: Passed for installs and recovery, campaign session recovery, and support follow-up.
shelf_truth_line: Downloads are currently live for Linux, but Windows and macOS still lack the promoted desktop installer proof this release says they need.
